verses.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.pt: Quando Israel saiu do Egito, e a casa de Jacó dentre um povo de língua estranha,
verses.en_web: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language;
verses.en_bbe: When Israel came out of Egypt, the children of Jacob from a people whose language was strange to them;

verses.en: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
verses.pt: Judá tornou-lhe o santuário, e Israel o seu domínio.
verses.en_web: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.en_bbe: Judah became his holy place, and Israel his kingdom.

verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.pt: O mar viu isto, e fugiu; o Jordão tornou atrás.
verses.en_web: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
verses.en_bbe: The sea saw it, and went in flight; Jordan was turned back.

verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.pt: Os montes saltaram como carneiros, e os outeiros como cordeiros do rebanho.
verses.en_web: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
verses.en_bbe: The mountains were jumping like goats, and the little hills like lambs.

verses.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.pt: Que tens tu, ó mar, para fugires? e tu, ó Jordão, para tornares atrás?
verses.en_web: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.en_bbe: What was wrong with you, O sea, that you went in flight? O Jordan, that you were turned back?

verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.pt: E vós, montes, que saltais como carneiros, e vós outeiros, como cordeiros do rebanho?
verses.en_web: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?
verses.en_bbe: You mountains, why were you jumping like goats, and you little hills like lambs?

verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.pt: Treme, ó terra, na presença do Senhor, na presença do Deus de Jacó,
verses.en_web: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.en_bbe: Be troubled, O earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob;

verses.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.pt: o qual converteu a rocha em lago de águas, a pederneira em manancial.
verses.en_web: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
verses.en_bbe: Who made the rock into a water-spring, and the hard stone into a fountain.
